evidence_text: Bit Holyfield's ears, was disqualified and his licence was revoked.

evidence_text: Married Corinna Betsch in August 1995.

evidence_text: Joined Ferrari for 1996 after two titles with Benetton.

evidence_text: Barefoot water-hazard shot preceded her U.S. Women's Open playoff win.

evidence_text: Named 1998 LPGA Rookie of the Year.
